biggest_catch: LanguaTalk's official tutor page publishes concrete commission and payout timing, but tutors set their own rates - there is no official worker pay.
catches: Tutors set their own lesson prices, so there is no platform-wide pay rate.
16% commission on each lesson (aiming to reduce to 15%).
Trial lessons can be free for new students.
Only about 5-10% of applicants are accepted.

c1.evidence: Official teach page: 'You set your rate per lesson' - no platform-wide pay rate published.

c2.evidence: Official teach page: 'Payment will be sent automatically to your bank account once per month... on the 5th of each month... for lessons given during the previous month.'

c3.evidence: Applying is free; no upfront fee documented.

c4.evidence: Official timing exists, but no official concrete pay rate - fails the pay requirement.

eligibility: Native or near-native speaker of the language you teach, some teaching experience, English at B1 level or above.
maximize: LanguaTalk is rejected here because tutors set their own lesson prices - its official teach page publishes no concrete platform-wide worker pay. Official mechanics worth knowing: commission is capped at 16% of each lesson price, lessons are 55 minutes, payouts are automatic to your bank once per month on the 5th for the previous month's lessons, and students get one free trial session (or 30% of your rate for repeat triallists).
notes: LanguaTalk has strong official payout terms but self-set rates, so it cannot be verified.
